integrity: Self-contained analytic proof of limit, exact identity, equality and angular phase; finite quadrature is illustrative. No external independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
limitations: Planar, centered, orthogonal thin rectangles only; limiting second variation, not unrestricted geometry or a finite-width uniform theorem. Putterman (2026) full text was not inspected, and unindexed formula overlap remains possible.
title: Sharp commutator law for Gaussian thin-rectangle curvature
